title: KS-624: Make prism refuse to issue fake credentials, make it real, or leave it as a stub?
bluf: services/prism issues credentials whose Ed25519 proof is 64 random bytes and its /verify returns passed:true without checking. PRISM_MODE is never branched on and /health reports mode 'basic' while forging. Reachability: the gateway routes only /api/did to prism and nothing in the repo calls it, so the risk is latent, not live (ticket measurement). The same pattern was fixed in vc-issuer (A-11) and in wallet-connector (PR #685, 501). The deciding question is whether prism has a real future. Also affects the sibling KS-625.

sources.quote: PRISM_MODE is decorative. It is never branched on
The gateway does not route to prism's credential path

options.label: Prism refuses to issue (501), stops reporting 'basic' (agent build; small prod change)
options.detail: Honest stub, the shape wallet-connector C-2 took. No internal consumers per ticket.

options.label: Make prism a real DID/VC service using the A-11 vc-issuer fix as template (big build)
options.detail: Larger Wave-2 build; not sized in the ticket. Production change.

options.label: By design: leave prism unchanged (latent), record the reason
options.detail: No change. A false 'basic' answer and forged proofs remain one route mapping from reachable.

default_action: After 48 h nothing changes (option c holding state, latent per the ticket). Reversible; the ticket stays parked for your ruling.
